content.comment_body: Hi, I have a question regarding programming with [product_name] [version_no]. Is it possible to create a control program where an engine is instructed to reach a certain target revolutions per minute, gradually increasing speed until the desired RPM is achieved? For example, I would like to increment the speed by 10 revolutions per second until it reaches 1000 RPM. Thank you.
Hello, are you one of the users from France?
No, I'm not. Why do you ask?
That explains my question. It's unusual for two different users to ask the exact same programming question within a short span of time.

You can utilize the 'Analog ramp' block for this. There is an example shown in the attached screen video. Please note, however, that the speed in simulation does not necessarily match the speed in a real [product_name].
Thank you, that was very helpful and answered my question.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked whether [product_name] [version_no] can be programmed to gradually increase a motor's speed to a defined RPM with controlled acceleration. Another user confirmed this is possible using the 'Analog ramp' block and cautioned that simulation speed may differ from an actual device. The initial user expressed appreciation, indicating their issue was resolved.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for [product_name] [version_no] to support programming incremental motor speed increase, enabling definition of target RPMs and acceleration rates.
